scope: local Qwen TTS provider-client request property semantics
claims: The provider client accepts only allowlisted string-named own fields.
Every accepted request field must be an enumerable data property before any request value is read.
Symbol, hidden and accessor fields fail before fetch, and rejected accessors are never executed.
limitations: No Tailnet or Provider request was made.
Real synthesis and retained-media graphical-browser evidence remain gated.
